test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Awareness (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Match the columns:

 
 

 
 
**Column A **

 
**(Land-Use Category)**

 
 
 
**Column B**

 
**(Description - Shuffled)**

 
 
 

 
 
A.

 
 Miscellaneous Tree Crops & Groves 
 
 
1.

 
 Land left fallow for more than 1 year but less than 5 years
 
 

 
 
B.

 
 Culturable Wasteland
 
 
2.

 
 Privately owned land under orchards and fruit trees
 
 

 
 
C.

 
 Current Fallow
 
 
3.

 
 Land left uncultivated for over 5 years
 
 

 
 
D.

 
 Fallow other than Current Fallow
 
 
4.

 
 Land left fallow for one or less than one year
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: A - 2, B - 3, C - 4, D - 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Miscellaneous Tree Crops & Groves:** This category represents privately owned land under orchards and fruit trees, making it match with description 2.
 
• **Culturable Wasteland:** Refers to land left uncultivated for more than five years, aligning with description 3.
 
• **Current Fallow:** Describes land left fallow for one or less than one year, which corresponds to description 4.
 
• **Fallow other than Current Fallow:** Indicates land left fallow for more than one year but less than five years, matching description 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Land-Use Categories:** A classification system used in geography and agriculture to define how different land types are utilized for various purposes like cultivation, forestry, and habitation.
 
• **Fallow Land:** Land that is temporarily not cultivated to allow soil recovery and maintain fertility.
 
• **Culturable Wasteland:** Land that is available for cultivation but has not been used for agriculture for a prolonged period due to various reasons like lack of irrigation or poor soil quality.
 
• **Miscellaneous Tree Crops & Groves:** Represents land utilized for growing fruit-bearing trees, orchards, or other grove plantations, generally for commercial purposes.
 
• **Current vs. Non-Current Fallow:** Current fallow refers to land left unused for a short period (less than a year), while non-current fallow pertains to land left idle for longer durations (1-5 years or more).
